summary: Embryology: Concepts and Techniques in Modern Developmental Biology is an advanced research training course at the Marine Biological Laboratory (MBL) in Woods Hole, Massachusetts, United States. The course focuses on developmental biology and is taught onsite. The 2027 edition runs from 30 May to 13 July 2027, and applications are due by 1 February 2027.
highlights: Onsite course in Woods Hole, Massachusetts, from 30 May to 13 July 2027.
